checks: The original one-batch FFT and complete angular Taylor formulas are byte-for-byte retained inside angular_coefficients_one_batch.
Each FFT column and its complete-polynomial Taylor remainder are independent of all other polynomial columns; batches of eight retain every column and its original order.
The wrapper checks the common grid and exact DirectedFFT instance before batching. No Fourier coefficient, radial polynomial, scalar model fee, or error-tube term is truncated.
The new producer has its own explicit kind/source SHA and records the eight-polynomial contract; the original producer and its incomplete checkpoints are unchanged.
The consumer maps each explicitly allowed old/new native kind to its own original producer SHA and checks the small-batch contract only for the new kind.
All original complete/failure, input/dependency SHA, target/eta, full weight bytes, initial data, tube, contiguous original row and scalar-germ checks remain unchanged.
All checked parts feed the same single propagation with no error reset at interfaces; incomplete old or new reports still reject.
scope: Pure formula/storage and consumer identity review. Root independently executed the first-row bitwise JSON comparison; this reviewer did not rerun the large native.
